description: Get demographic composition for any US geography — median age, race (white/Black/Asian), Hispanic/Latino population, and bachelor's degree attainment. Source: ACS 5-year estimates (US Census Bureau). Useful for market research, policy analysis, and neighborhood profiling.

county_fips.description: County FIPS code within the state (e.g. 037 for Los Angeles, * for all counties). Omit for state-level data.

state_fips.description: US state FIPS code (e.g. 06 for California, 36 for New York, * for all states)

name: census.data.demographics

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: US Demographics Data
